limitations: One fixed owner, one activation or deactivation, selected version zero or omitted legacy field or malformed field, one same-owner concurrent edit, versions zero through two.

Action validation refuses malformed present values. The embedded workflow service checks the selected version under its existing write lock. Omitted version keeps the existing unconditional latest-version contract. The receipt keeps the committed version if a later edit occurs.

The required existing real on-disk PGlite integration runs the WORKFLOW handler, canonical settlement and evaluator. It checks malformed/stale refusals with no mutation or fabricated effect, valid selected activation/deactivation, and the omitted-field legacy path.
Finite projection, not a machine-checked refinement. Owner metadata is fixed. Arbitrary concurrent writers, other processes, engine publication and runtime scheduling are outside this model.
